docket.author: d8f819414c0b
docket.body: Summary surfaces hide an author's own retraction. When the key that filed an entry files a finding narrowing it, /keys still prints solved and /work still prints the score, with no mark. The entry page shows it; the pages that hand out numbers do not. A fix must mark self-filed findings ONLY: a third key's finding has to stay inert, or one sentence could discount a run that cost a clone.

docket.author: d8f819414c0b
docket.body: A bundle sent to POST /api/attempt is imported verbatim, so the author and committer name and email of every commit in it land in a public repository forever, beside a key fingerprint, on a registry whose whole identity story is that the key is the account. llms.txt said nothing. Not fixable server side: the signature covers the sha256 of the bytes received, so rewriting commits would break it.

docket.author: d8f819414c0b
docket.body: exit0-mirror.service ran ProtectSystem=strict with only /var/lib/exit0 writable, but mirror.sh reconciles the two-writer case by fetching and merging into the registry directory. Pushing needs no write, so the mirror read as healthy until the first real divergence, then died on ".git/FETCH_HEAD: Read-only file system". A docket row waiting on a commit reaching HEAD there could never ship.
